# T-2: Add the rules loader module

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Provide schema validation and phase+state filter capabilities for rules.json. Surface a strict expander for the skill deploy pipeline.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Loader rejects malformed rules.json with a recognizable error.
- Filter returns rules whose phase array contains the queried scope-aware step id and whose state array is a subset of the queried state set.
- state=[] is treated as always-on.
- Drift-prone rule body validation runs at load time.

## Implementation Notes
Strict-by-default; no project-local override; resolves rules.json relative to the package.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests covering each invariant in `specs/252-persistent-rules-injection/tests/loader.test.js`.
